title_en: The Stance of Allama Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on the Study of Philosophy and Mystical Gnosis ('Irfan) in the Seminaries (Hawzat)
summary: An exposition of religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari's perspective on the importance and integration of philosophy and mystical gnosis ('irfan) within the curricula of religious seminaries (hawzat).
